articles.title: Super Saturday Is Here: Haaland Takes On Kane in Miami, Messi Faces Switzerland in Kansas City
articles.excerpt: Two World Cup quarterfinals on American soil, four Golden Boot contenders, and a semifinal blockbuster already locked in. Here is what NRIs need to know about the biggest day of the tournament.
articles.image_caption: Erling Haaland, who has scored 7 goals in 4 World Cup matches, leads Norway into Saturday's quarterfinal against England in Miami (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Both World Cup quarterfinals are on US soil in Miami and Kansas City, giving NRIs a chance to attend or watch at community gatherings across diaspora hubs from Edison to Fremont.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Knight Riders Finally Crack the Code: LA Hands League-Leading SF Unicorns Their First MLC Defeat
articles.excerpt: A back-to-back surge from the LA Knight Riders — wins over Washington Freedom and the previously unbeaten San Francisco Unicorns — has injected life into the MLC Season 4 race.
articles.image_caption: Andre Russell, one of the LA Knight Riders' star all-rounders in MLC Season 4
articles.nri_angle: MLC is the only professional cricket league where NRIs can attend live T20 matches in American cities — the standings race directly shapes the diaspora's summer sports calendar.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
